description.text: V Starter Deck: Power, a random 60-card deck, ready to play out of the box, with damage counters and a rule book. Its Rillaboom, Cinderace and Inteleon V and VMAX have attacks different from the expansions' cards, and it brings a Darkness-type Gengar V and VMAX. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
